steps.note: Quintero after Kowalczyk went ahead: the security-office copy repeats the service-side line. At the outer lock, a player who picked the clock gets the 'Fair' line and no secret topic. The core copy, unwounded, says 'Door's mine'.

said: Service side. She always takes the door nobody's watching.
You picked the clock. Fair. It's still Tesseract's door, and he's holding it open for us.
He wants you on your own. I'll be on this side of the door.

notSaid: One arm's plenty for a door.
